To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) we have proposed a new fuzzy regression model, (2) we have introduced a set of indices to evaluate the quality of the results and (3) the proposed approach is valid and useful to analyze financial data.

(1) we propose a variety of models for fuzzy regression based on quadratic programming; (2) we introduce a set of quality indices for the obtained results; (3) the empirical study shows the validity and usefulness of the proposed models; (4) the results are applied in a case with real financial data.

(i) the quadratic programming approach to regression is a useful tool to analyze financial data, (ii) our approach allows the analyst to choose the best model for a specific data set, (iii) our models are more robust than those founded on linear programming and (iv) our models are able to detect the presence of outliers.
